BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

3. When learning Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floors 4.0 Building Services 4.1 Plu.

4. When learning Site Preparation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation.

5. When learning Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr.

6. When learning Timbering, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timbering.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Timbering.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timbering.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timbering.

7. When learning Introduction to Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction.

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

9. When learning Concreting, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Concreting.

10. When learning Isometric Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing.

11. When learning Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Concreting 3.2 Foundations 3.3 Timbering 3.4 Foundation Walling 3.5 Ground Floor.

12. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

13. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

14. When learning Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.

15. When learning Foundations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Foundations.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Foundations.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Foundations.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Foundations.

16. When learning Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Drawing 3.0 Building Construction Processes.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Plumbing Materials and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Pipework and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Construction 1.2 Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Building Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Site Preparation 2.0 Related Drawing 2.1 Isometric Drawing 2.2 Computer Aided Dr and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Site Preparation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
